subject: ventures/mrr-pulse
professional: a SaaS finance lead / RevOps analyst who builds the monthly MRR bridge from Stripe and reports NRR and logo churn to investors; first check: does the bridge tie out at the customer level and does each rate match the standard definition

PASS: yearly/quarterly normalisation (2417, 10000); hand waterfall NRR .85, GRR .75, QR .8, revenue churn .20; e2e MRR 24000 and Oct NRR 0.8276 with only GET; JPY ¥1,000 (fixed since the last audit, PR #17099); Canceled At + Ended At export dates churn at Ended At (fixed, PR #16179); canceled-without-end rows skipped; expanded discounts netted and the list call now expands them (PR #17855). Only chart.mjs:6's stacked bars are promised and not drawn. 3.

evidence.craft: Read metrics.mjs, stripe.mjs, csv.mjs, server.mjs, page.mjs, chart.mjs, index.html. Small pure modules, zero deps, escaped output, timing-safe auth, prototype-safe dicts, strict CSV import with reasons, 403 fallback for expand. Defects: two concentration engines with different semantics on one dashboard (concentration() per subscription at metrics.mjs:262, breakdown() per customer: same data gives top1 0.4 vs 0.6); status lists repeated in liveMap/mapAt/cohorts/breakdown/server; 1,000-char one-line templates in page.mjs; stale chart comment. 3.
evidence.claims: Backed: read-only GET (e2e, stripe.test); clone command (source and served copy); server dashboard NRR '(monthly)' and quick-ratio caption (page.test.mjs); coupon netting now that the list expands discounts; disclaimer on README, index.html and dashboard. Not backed: browser-demo NRR tile unlabelled (index.html:119); index.html 'What counts as MRR?' omits tiered prices; 'Customers' tile and 'logo churn' count subscriptions, disclosed only in README Known gaps, not on the page, dashboard or llms.txt; README Known gaps still lists the CSV Canceled At defect that is fixed (stale). 2.
evidence.fitness: Walked an indie founder's job: paste a Stripe export or deploy with an rk_ key and read MRR/NRR/churn weekly. Works for flat-priced subscriptions, now including JPY and coupons on new API versions. Still wrong for seat-tiered pricing (silent 0), add-on subscriptions or plan changes done as cancel+create (inflated logo churn, NRR 0), and the unpaid-status history hole. 2.
evidence.domain: Against ChartMogul/Baremetrics practice and SaaS finance texts: movements are classified per customer per month, net of intra-month changes, logo churn counts customers, NRR is quoted trailing-12-month. Here movements and logo churn remain per subscription and gross per sync, NRR is monthly only, tiered prices unmodelled. Normalisation (interval_count, quantity, metered/trials/incomplete excluded, trial-end start, zero-decimal currencies) now matches common practice. 2.

defects.what: Logo churn, the Customers tile and every MRR movement are still per subscription, not per customer (customer id used only in breakdown()). Add-on drop = 0.333 logo churn (expected 0); plan swap via cancel+create = logo churn 1.0, NRR 0 (expected NRR 1.6). Disclosed in README Known gaps since PR #15653 but not on the page, dashboard or llms.txt

Tiered (graduated/volume) prices still contribute 0 MRR: unit_amount null falls back to 0. README now says they are not counted, but the dashboard gives no count of excluded subscriptions and index.html's 'What counts as MRR?' omits them, so a seat-tiered company sees a silently low headline
A subscription whose current status is unpaid (or paused with no ended_at) is dropped from every past month of the rebuilt history (22 months of 5000 -> 0,0,0,0) instead of churning at a date
NRR is a one-month figure with no trailing-12-month NRR; the browser demo tile at index.html:119 still says 'Net revenue retention' without '(monthly)' (the server dashboard was fixed)
Movements are summed per sync, so a downgrade and re-upgrade within one month books 2000 contraction and 2000 expansion instead of netting per customer per month

verdict: Re-audit of the 2026-11-13 audit, whose listed fix PR #15653 only changed labels, the clone command and the README (it added a Known gaps section). Since then eight red-team PRs fixed real mechanics: zero-decimal currencies (#17099), Stripe-export alias priority so churn dates at Ended At (#16179), and coupon netting on new Stripe API versions via expand[] (#17855); tests grew from 62 to 119, all passing. Of the 12 prior defects, 5 are closed, 5 partial and 2 open. The headline defect is untouched: logo churn, Customers and the MRR bridge are per subscription, so a customer swapping a 5,000 plan for an 8,000 one shows logo churn 100% and NRR 0 instead of NRR 160%; tiered prices still count 0 MRR silently; an unpaid subscription's history vanishes. 3 of 8 seeded mutants survive, the same three the last audit found. Correctness, claims and verification stay at 2, so it does not meet the bar; it does what its README lists (completeness 3). Scores are unchanged from 2026-11-13: the fixes closed the narrower defects, not the gap a finance lead would hit first.
